title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of twelve curves. Begin with the first arc starting at coordinates (0.0, 0.0019), with its midpoint at (0.0005, 0.0005), and ending at (0.0019, 0.0). Follow this with the first line from (0.0019, 0.0) to (0.0606, 0.0). Continue with the second arc starting at (0.0606, 0.0), midpoint at (0.062, 0.0005), and ending at (0.0625, 0.0019). Add the second line from (0.0625, 0.0019) to (0.0625, 0.025), then the third line from (0.0625, 0.025) to (0.0588, 0.025). Draw the fourth line from (0.0588, 0.025) to (0.0588, 0.0069), followed by the third arc starting at (0.0588, 0.0069), midpoint at (0.0578, 0.0047), and ending at (0.0556, 0.0038). Add the fifth line from (0.0556, 0.0038) to (0.0069, 0.0038), then the fourth arc starting at (0.0069, 0.0038), midpoint at (0.0047, 0.0047), and ending at (0.0038, 0.0069). Complete the loop with the sixth line from (0.0038, 0.0069) to (0.0038, 0.025), the seventh line from (0.0038, 0.025) to (0.0, 0.025), and the eighth line from (0.0, 0.025) back to (0.0, 0.0019). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0625. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.0625 units in length, 0.025 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = (
    r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0019)
    .threePointArc((0.0005, 0.0005), (0.0019, 0.0))
    .lineTo(0.0606, 0.0)
    .threePointArc((0.062, 0.0005), (0.0625, 0.0019))
    .lineTo(0.0625, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.0588, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.0588, 0.0069)
    .threePointArc((0.0578, 0.0047), (0.0556, 0.0038))
    .lineTo(0.0069, 0.0038)
    .threePointArc((0.0047, 0.0047), (0.0038, 0.0069))
    .lineTo(0.0038, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0019)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch (if necessary)
# Note: The sketch scale is applied to the sketch before extrusion, but in this case, it is 0.0625 which is the same as the length.
# Therefore, we do not need to scale the sketch explicitly in this example.

# Final model
r  # This will represent the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# C-channel extruded along Z
# Outer dimensions: X = 0.0625, Y = 0.0250, height Z = 0.7500
# Wall thickness
t = 0.005

X = 0.0625
Y = 0.0250
H = 0.7500

# Create the U-shaped profile on the XY plane
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(X, 0)
    .lineTo(X, Y)
    .lineTo(X - t, Y)
    .lineTo(X - t, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, Y)
    .lineTo(0, Y)
    .close()
    .extrude(H)
)

import cadquery as cq

X = 0.0625
Y = 0.0250
Z = 0.7500
w = 0.00625  # uniform wall thickness

pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (X, 0.0),
    (X, Y),
    (X - w, Y),
    (X - w, w),
    (w, w),
    (w, Y),
    (0.0, Y),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(Z)
